section.title: auth-service.properties
section.codeblock: auth.signing.key=file:/etc/auth/signing.pem auth.signing.algorithm=RS512 auth.token.ttl=7200 auth.token.refresh.ttl=43200 auth.token.issuer=https://auth.example.com auth.session.enabled=false auth.session.timeout=900 auth.ratelimit.enabled=true auth.ratelimit.requests=1200 auth.ratelimit.burst=100 auth.ratelimit.window=30 db.pool.min=20 db.pool.max=400 db.pool.timeout=3000 db.schema.revision=47 db.statement.timeout=10000 http.port=8443 http.tls.enabled=true http.tls.protocol=TLSv1.3 http.tls.ciphers=strict http.compression=true http.max.header.size=16384 log.level=WARN log.audit.enabled=true log.audit.retention.days=90 log.format=json cache.entry.ttl=600 cache.max.entries=50000 cache.eviction.interval=15 metrics.enabled=true metrics.port=9090 metrics.prefix=authsvc health.path=/healthz health.timeout=1000
